questions.question: How old is Franek?
questions.explanation: The text: "Franek was ten years old."

questions.question: What does Franek promise when he asks for Karolek?
answers: That he will never play a prank again
That he will stop going to school
That he will give away all his toys
questions.explanation: He swears he will never play a single prank again.

questions.question: Who does Franek ask to teach him to read?
questions.explanation: He asks his father to teach him to read for Karolek's sake.

questions.question: What does Franek read to Karolek in the evenings?
questions.explanation: He reads about squirrels, chestnuts, autumn leaves, friendship.

questions.question: How does Franek change in the eyes of the neighbours?
answers: From a "scamp" into a respected boy
